senses.gloss: (v. <cite ref="P00198"><he>עוּד</he></cite>, a. <cite ref="F00015"><he>וָדָה</he></cite>; Sam. <he>סעד</he>, <he>סהד</he>, v. Sam. Pent.
units: Gen. XXXI, 52; cmp. also סעד = עַד ib. VII, 16; for interch. of ע a. ו a. ה, v. letters ה a. ו) to be sure, be present; to witness
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 20:13">Targ. O. Ex. XX, 13</cite>; a. fr.—

Ib. לא צריך איהו לאַסְהוּדֵי וכ׳ he would not need to identify his own signature; ואזל איהו והאי ומַסְהֲדֵי וכ׳ (or ומְסַהֲדֵי Pa.) and thus he and the other man might identify the signature of that man (the deceased); a. v. fr.

senses.gloss: to call to witness; to give warning.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 81:9">Targ. Ps. LXXXI, 9</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 33:10">Targ. II Chr. XXXIII, 10</cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 20:13">Targ. Y. Ex. XX, 13</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Ketubot 21a:4">Keth. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>מְסַהֲדֵי</he>, v. supra. Y. Snh. I, 18ᵇ top <he>איתא שַׂהַד עלי</he> come, testify in my behalf. Y. Shebu. VI, end, 37ᵇ <he>כאינש … דלא יְשַׂהֲדוּן</he> like one that ties up the mouth of witnesses that they may not testify; a. fr.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 43:3">Targ. Y. Gen. XLIII, 3</cite> <he>מְסַהֲדָא אַסְהֵיד</he>; a. e.
